baseline: H0 current Champion; D0 DM-20260910-03 T3 exact reproduction

feature_definitions.turnover: raw Volume_t / last strictly-prior disclosed issued-and-outstanding shares including treasury stock; shares age <=450 days
feature_definitions.log_turnover: log(TO + 1e-12), only where TO is finite
feature_definitions.abnormal_turnover: log TO_t minus median(log TO_t-1 ... log TO_t-60), strictly-prior 60-row rolling median

representations.U1: ATO*I(residual>0) and ATO*I(residual<0), each chronological + sorted
representations.R1: ATO and ATO*residual, each chronological + sorted

feature_definitions.missing_history: incomplete/nonfinite feature vector is neutral 0; no row is dropped

model: daily cross-sectional percentile-rank target; StandardScaler + ElasticNet; annual expanding fits; same finite DM-20260910-03 past-only RankIC selection

parameters.hyperparameter_source: DM-20260910-03 RANK selected by preregistered past-only RankIC grid

selection_rule.dti_salvage: pooled Net SR > 0; positive Net-SR folds >=3/4; annual Net >0
selection_rule.champion_replacement: pooled Net SR > H0 and improved Net-SR folds >=3/4
selection_rule.long_success: pooled Long Net SR >0 and positive Long folds >=3/4
selection_rule.short_success: pooled Short Net SR >0 and positive Short folds >=3/4
